answer: Each new identity posts a 60-credit bond and starts at 20% on the lowest mesa. It climbs one mesa per verified epoch: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, full rate after five epochs. Auditors stamp each epoch with an umber seal bound to the bond key; one seal serves one identity. The bond sits in a glacier vault thawing only as each mesa is climbed; a caught fake forfeits it. The kth fake still posts a fresh 60 and restarts at 20%, so 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 credits. Renting a graduated identity fails: transfer resets the holder to 20% and freezes the bond. One honest agent posts 60 once.
